# upscale

> Local AI image upscaler. Chains Real-ESRGAN (via spandrel) 4x passes to reach any target scale, with feather-blended overlapping tiles for seam-free output. CPU or NVIDIA GPU. Python package `upscaler`, console script `upscale`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/wwylon/upscale/blob/main/README.md): install and quick start
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/wwylon/upscale/blob/main/docs/cli.md)
- [HTTP and MCP API](https://github.com/wwylon/upscale/blob/main/docs/api.md)
- [Development](https://github.com/wwylon/upscale/blob/main/docs/develop.md)
- [Agent notes](https://github.com/wwylon/upscale/blob/main/AGENTS.md)

## Key facts

- `upscale upscale IN OUT --scale N` or `--target-size PX`; `--cpu` forces CPU
- `upscale serve` starts a local web UI and job API; `upscale mcp` runs MCP tools over stdio
- Models download on first use and are hash-verified; no telemetry
